commit.message:
docs: refresh repository presentation

- Package rename: update all 20 Java import statements from the
  deprecated com.aspose.cells_foss namespace to the current, real
  org.aspose.cells_foss namespace (matching the live upstream package
  layout as of the current master), so every code example compiles
  against the currently published library.
- Restore a Project Structure section (box-drawing directory tree,
  matching the corrected, current source layout) and reconcile
  Enterprise Edition badge/package coordinates against verified,
  live sources.
- Rework the At-a-Glance diagram: remove two duplicated nodes whose
  content already exists as real Capabilities (embedded-picture
  bytes as a Starting Point, load-diagnostics reporting as an
  Output), keeping only genuinely distinct inputs/outputs.
- Rewrite the Key Capabilities section for natural, varied phrasing
  (reduced repetitive "`Identifier` does X" openings from 82% to 27%
  of bullets) while preserving every documented class, method, and
  fact exactly as verified against the real source.
- Every code example, class/member reference, and diagram claim in
  this candidate was checked against the real, current published
  source and API surface before being included.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
